meta.name: alfworld-receptacle-navigator
meta.description: Plans and executes movement to a target receptacle within the ALFWorld environment. Use when the agent needs to reach a specific location before interacting with objects there (e.g., go to fridge to cool an item, go to garbagecan to dispose of an item). Takes a receptacle identifier as input, executes the `go to` action, and outputs confirmation of arrival at the destination.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照指示在 ALFWorld 环境中移动到指定的容器（如冰箱、垃圾桶等），并确认到达，为后续操作做准备。
howto.when: 当需要先到达一个位置才能与物体交互时触发，比如“去冰箱冷却物品”或“去垃圾桶丢弃物品”。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to plan and execute movement to a specified receptacle (e.g., fridge, garbage can) in ALFWorld, confirming arrival for subsequent interactions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the agent needs to reach a location before interacting with objects, e.g., "go to fridge to cool an item" or "go to garbagecan to dispose of an item".
